Design & Fabrication of a Bifold Steel Folding Cot

A compact portable sleeping cot constructed from 1-inch Mild Steel square hollow section pipes, heavy-duty center butt hinges, 3 sets of pivoting U-legs, and a high-tension hand-woven cotton/nylon Niwar webbing deck.

Center Fold 180° Clamshell
Frame Steel 1" MS Square Tube
Deck Surface Woven Niwar

Engineering Principles

Structural & Kinematic Design

01

Center Butt Hinge Axis

Heavy-duty mild steel butt hinges welded directly onto parallel center tubes allow the 6-foot bed frame to fold cleanly into a 3-foot compact sandwich.

02

Tri-Leg Load Distribution

Three sets of U-shaped leg assemblies positioned at the left end, center joint, and right end ensure uniform weight transfer through 6 anti-slip rubber feet.

03

Woven Niwar Webbing Deck

Interwoven cotton and nylon straps wrapped around the outer steel frame tubes provide high tensile support, flex resilience, and breathable airflow.

Kinematic Operation

Pivoting both symmetric mild-steel frame halves 90° vertically brings the bed halves together into a 180° total clamshell fold, while all 3 leg sets rotate flat against the frame rails.
